banner:
iPhone 14, first visit: no intro, hint or welcome on phones (app.js:94).
Nothing says drag / pinch / tap; the guide is behind the (?) icon.
Welcome sheet (only via the ? icon): desktop wording (click, / key, ? key).

Two-finger pinch that starts on the dock: the PAGE zooms to 5x (visualViewport.scale=5).
All controls are off-screen; the zoom even survives a reload (Chromium).

Pinch that starts on a city banner (Karachi): page zooms to 5x instead of the map.
Banners are pointer-events:auto with no touch-action (style.css:170).

Tour running, user taps a hex: the inspector opens as a 15% ghost that still
catches every tap and drag in the bottom half (#hud > * beats body.touring rule).
Pinned tour card on top, ghost inspector text bleeding through below it.

Play all (cinema): the tour badge sits exactly under the cinema ✕ (z 40 > 26).
The 'top: +52px' cinema rule loses on specificity (tourchip.css:16 vs :9).
Landscape 844x390, K2 tour stop: wonder labels cut by the left edge.

Tap a row in Explorer: the camera flies, the inspector opens, and Explorer is closed
(one-sheet rule). Sort, scroll and brush are lost; reopening starts over.

Walkthrough step 2 on a phone: desktop gestures and keys; spotlight is an arbitrary
column (guide.js:136, 141).

Step 14 (Explorer): the card covers the panel's header and controls; 5 of 19 steps
overlap like this, the last step has no target at all (.guide-btn is hidden).
Tour card, iPhone 14: amber = under 44px, red = under 32px.
Era Time-Machine: era ticks 26px tall, slider thumb ~16px, 11px text.
Duel: preset chips 24px, inputs 32px, name truncated ('South Karac...').

iPad 820x1180 (touch) gets the DESKTOP layout: 39 targets <44px, 31 <32px.
No Explorer entry point (yields hidden <=900px).
iPad 820 tour: end-tour ✕ is 13x13px, step controls 31x27px.
360px Android, paused tour card: two identical ▶ buttons; shrink sits next to end-tour.
City View sheet: 9.5-11.5px mono/uppercase micro-labels throughout.
Landscape: Explorer shows 5 table rows; the plot is below the fold of a 240px panel.
360px: the 13-column table needs sideways scrolling; only District/Province visible.
OK: with 47/34px insets (CDP override) nothing sits under the island or home bar.
OK: iPhone SE with both Safari bars (375x553): sheets fit, dvh-based sizing holds.
768x1024 gets the phone layout: usable by touch, if sparse on a big screen.
OK: landscape 844x390 moves the dock to a right rail; the country fits the free space.
